'''Futbolo Klubas Šilutė''' (before 2003, '''Laisvė Šilutė''') is a [[Lithuania]]n [[football (soccer)|football]] team from the city of [[Šilutė]]. The team plays in the [[II Lyga]], the third tier of [[Football in Lithuania|Lithuanian football]]. A notable former player of the club is [[Adebayo Akinfenwa]]."}}
